mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE indicates a tightening labor market, boosting productivity and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with simultaneous PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO, signaling strengthening industrial production, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window during non-recessionary periods, or 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating increased retail sales, consumer confidence is boosted, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances with RSAFS exceeding its 6-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in CPIAUCSL, signaling reduced inflationary pressures, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as the Fed is less likely to raise interest rates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window during low-inflation periods, or 60-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST, indicating a strengthening housing market, boosts economic growth expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only when UNRATE is below 8%.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances with HOUST increase and UNRATE below 8%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decrease in UNRATE and increase in PAYEMS, signaling a rapidly tightening labor market, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as inflation concerns rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances with simultaneous UNRATE decrease and PAYEMS increase.
